name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.9 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 16 times in 7 visits over 75 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 32 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.1 days starting 2026-06-01, at wavelengths from 0.85 to 4.41 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
